title: Assessing the Short-Term Efficacy of Digital Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia With Different Types of Coaching: Randomized Controlled Comparative Trial.
authors: Chan WS, Cheng WY, Lok SHC, Cheah AKM, Lee AKW, Ng ASY, Kowatsch T.
figures: CONSORT (Consolidated Standards of Reporting Trials) flowchart of participants. dCBTi: digital cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia.

Changes in outcomes from baseline to follow-up.
